title: A third of webpages published since ChatGPT’s launch show signs of AI authorship, study finds
summary: Pew then used Open Pangram’s technology to detect how many were likely written or heavily edited by AI. In a random sample of 10,000 webpages collected in July 2026, around 10% showed “significant signs of AI authorship,” Pew said.
